title: What AgentForge Sentinel does
answer: Sentinel is a research workbench for reviewing financial documents and investigating flagged transactions. The document tool extracts evidence locally in the browser. The synthetic workbench shows the full chain from a risk signal to an investigator’s recommendation, a human approval and an audited simulated action.

title: What makes Sentinel useful
answer: Sentinel links findings to source pages, worksheets or Word text; shows the math where it can calculate it; and exposes gaps where evidence is missing. Its case workflow records claim checks, requires analyst approval for the exact proposed action, and preserves an audit trail. A risk flag starts a review. The evidence is what you can verify.

title: How document review works
answer: The browser reads searchable PDFs, XLSX files and DOCX files up to 10 MB. Supported invoice layouts show the math and the source, Treasury statements can show published receipts and outlays, and suitable workbooks show separate totals by currency. Scanned PDFs need searchable text. Save older DOC files as DOCX first.

title: How to verify a public example
answer: Try the January or May 2025 U.S. Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement in the sample selector. Compare the reported receipts, outlays and deficit in Sentinel with the This Month column in Table 2 on PDF page 5. The labeled bank statement is a separate synthetic example.

title: Where your file goes
answer: The document and its extracted text are processed inside your browser. IAF is a separate project explainer and receives only questions you type into its own form. The project knowledge is curated for public use.

title: How the case workflow works
answer: Sentinel flags a synthetic transaction, pins the case evidence, checks investigation claims and prepares a proposal. An analyst must separately approve that exact proposal before a simulated action can execute. Repeating the execution request returns the original action record.

title: How the research dataset was built
answer: The p1 snapshot contains 82,819 generated transactions across 600 fictional accounts. It uses chronological training, validation and test periods. Synthetic labels support a reproducible evaluation; they do not measure real-world fraud detection performance.

title: Who built AgentForge Sentinel
answer: Phaneendra Gavara (PHANI465 on GitHub) built AgentForge Sentinel. His public portfolio describes his work on AI agents, retrieval pipelines and data systems, and lists an M.S. in Data Science from Arizona State University.

title: How IAF retrieves answers
answer: IAF means I am Antifraud. It retrieves answers from a curated public library covering Sentinel and its creator, and shows the source for each answer. When enabled, the OpenAI model selects among the retrieved answers. IAF never takes a case action or analyzes your file.
